# Test fixtures

Files that are read by the suite rather than generated by it.

## `freecad_part.step` (optional)

A STEP file exported by a real CAD system, used by
`tests/integration/test_import_step_pipeline.py` to check the import
against something the geometry kernel did not write itself: product
names, assembly structure and unit declarations differ between
exporters, and a kernel-written file cannot expose that.

The test skips when the file is absent, so the suite runs without it.
Drop in any small export (a few solids, named parts) to enable it.
